names.note: Read out of the title on his name link behind the company's line for 31 октября ст. ст., «Всеволод (Смирнов), протоиерей, сщмч.», with the grade and the rank word left off. The line itself gives the forename in the genitive among six others and no surname.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru prints «(1937)» after the line of ten people he is the first of. Nothing else on the calendar dates him: no life page follows his name, and his name page carries two days, an icon and no text.

feast.note: His name page lists one other day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia. One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 31 октября ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Всеволода , Александра , Сергия и Алексия и Василия , Петра , Василия пресвитеров, прмч. Анатолия , Евфросина и мч. Иакова (1937).»
source.note: The line is the seventh of the day and names ten people with one year for all of them; his is the first name on it. The day carries one typikon sign only, «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком», so no rank is recorded.

attestations.note: The line's «Сщмчч.» and «пресвитеров» are hieromartyr and presbyter and go in `types`; the link's «протоиерей» is the grade and goes in `office` as Archpriest. **He is not the corpus's `vsevolod-presbyter-martyr-1937`**, who is Vsevolod Potyominsky, born 1870 and shot in the same year but kept on the Julian 6 сентября, with his own line «Сщмчч. Иоанна и Всеволода пресвитеров (1937)»; two commemorations on one calendar are two men by the settled rule, and the surnames differ. The surname «Смирнов» is held by three other folders — `alexander-smirnov`, `alexis-smirnov` and others — all on other Julian days. His name page is the only one of the eight thin ones on this line that carries an icon. The ten on this line are not recorded as a company: no page read says they were tried together, and sharing a day of death is not a relation.
